mapper.insert: insert into match_tbl(creatorId, title, createAt, startTime, status, location, url, people, kategorie, anonymousCondi, mannerCondi, genderCondi, chatCode) values(#{creatorId},#{title},#{createAt},#{startTime},#{status},#{location},#{url},#{people}, #{kategorie},#{anonymousCondi},#{mannerCondi},#{genderCondi},#{chatCode});
insert into chat_tbl(type, hostId, chatTitle) values(#{type},#{hostId},#{chatTitle});
mapper.select: select * from match_tbl m left join matchtag_tbl t on m.matchId = t.matchId;
